en: The postcard shows a tree-lined avenue leading up to an ornate building with a decorative entrance and a flag on top. The path is flanked by wooden fences and large trees, giving the scene a serene, park-like atmosphere. There is handwritten script in Swedish across the bottom and top of the image. The words 'Tivoli' and 'Sundsvall' are printed in the lower part of the card, indicating the location.
